description: Client/provider SPL escrow with proof-then-confirm release on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1). initialize_protocol, create_escrow, accept_escrow, submit_proof and confirm_completion were verified: 1_000_000 lab tokens were locked, the provider submitted a SignedConfirmation, and confirm_completion paid the provider exactly 1_000_000 (0 bps fee) and closed the escrow account.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of cruellacodes/escrowagent. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/escrowagent. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is the lab build. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (initialize_protocol, create_escrow, accept_escrow, submit_proof, confirm_completion)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/escrowagent/
QA: devnet proof of the MultiSigConfirm happy path with a 0 bps protocol fee
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
raise_dispute, resolve_dispute, expire_escrow, provider_release, and non-zero protocol fees

assignments.title: Exercise raise_dispute and resolve_dispute with a non-zero protocol fee
